texts: good. the unknown sits in the object slot of the investing event, the Council stays the investing party, both date terms ride the event, and the conferred Keeper role is rebuilt as the state the investing brought about — the same shape an "invested X as a Keeper" statement is stored in, so the answer binds. It does ask for that full conferred-role bundle, so an appointment recorded some other way (a plain "X was a Keeper from day 260") would not be reached by this question.
